description: Read and manage the user's MIND notification inbox — alerts, reminders, insight pings, and system messages generated by other MIND features. It is not a way to send a notification yourself. Use this to check what MIND has already surfaced to the user, or to clear it down; for the underlying event (why an insight fired, what an alert refers to) follow up with the originating tool (mind_insights, mind_sense, etc.) or mind_query. Actions: list, mark_read, mark_all_read, stats (total/unread/read counts). 'No notifications' or unread:0 means nothing has been pushed to the inbox — a quiet inbox and a quiet graph are different claims.

action.description: Action: list (view notifications), mark_read (single), mark_all_read (all), stats (overview)

name: mind_notify
